name: Content Craft AI: SEO & AI Article Generator
author: FluxLogic

sections.description:
Content Craft AI is a powerful WordPress plugin that creates high-quality, undetectable AI content using advanced models like GPT-4. Generate articles that rank well in search engines while bypassing common AI detection tools like GPTZero and Originality.ai.

🎥 Watch the demo video:

🚀 Core Features:

  • 🤖 Undetectable AI Content – Our advanced algorithms produce human-like content that bypasses AI detection tools
  • 📝 Article Generation – Create complete articles from keywords or topics with customizable word count
  • 🔍 SEO Optimization – Built-in SEO best practices ensure your content ranks well
  • 🌎 Multilingual Support – Generate content in multiple languages including English, French, Spanish, and German
  • 📅 Scheduling – Plan your content calendar with scheduled article generation
  • 📊 Quality Control – Edit and refine generated content before publishing
  • 📈 Performance Tracking – Monitor your content performance over time
  • 🔄 WordPress Integration – Seamless integration with your existing WordPress workflow
  • 🖼️ Image Integration – Automatic image insertion and featured image generation
  • 🔗 Smart Linking – Intelligent internal and external linking

⚡ Key Benefits:

  • ⏱️ Save Time – Generate high-quality articles in minutes instead of hours
  • 💵 Reduce Costs – Cut content creation expenses by up to 80%
  • 📊 Boost SEO – Content optimized for search engines drives more traffic
  • 🔄 Maintain Consistency – Create content with consistent quality and tone
  • 🌐 Reach Global Audience – Generate content in multiple languages
  • 📱 Mobile-Friendly UI – Manage your content on any device
  • 🛡️ Secure Implementation – Built with WordPress security best practices

External Services

This plugin connects to the ContentCraft AI API (https://content-craft-api-railway-production.up.railway.app/api/v1/) to provide its core functionality.

What information is sent to the ContentCraft API

  1. User Authentication: When you register or log in, your email address and password are securely transmitted to verify your account.

  2. Content Generation: When generating articles or keywords, your content request (including topic, keywords, and preferences) is sent to our AI processing servers.

  3. User Data: Basic information like your WordPress domain, username, and email are used to manage your account and subscription.

  4. Generation Status: The plugin regularly checks the status of your content generation requests to update you on progress.

  5. Payment Processing: If you upgrade to a paid plan, your subscription information is processed through our secure payment gateway.

When is the data sent

  • Authentication data is only sent when you log in, register, or perform password recovery.
  • Content generation data is only sent when you explicitly request new content.
  • Generation status checks occur automatically for in-progress content requests.
  • Account information is checked when viewing your dashboard or account details.

The data is transmitted securely via HTTPS. No data is shared with third parties beyond what is necessary to provide the service.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the content-craft-ai folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to the ContentCraft AI settings page to configure your API keys
  4. Start generating AI content that bypasses detection tools!
sections.faq:
What AI models does ContentCraft AI use?

ContentCraft AI uses advanced AI models including GPT-4o-mini and GPT-4 to generate high-quality content that bypasses AI detection.

Can AI detection tools identify content created with ContentCraft AI?

No, our proprietary technology produces human-like content that successfully bypasses common AI detection tools like GPTZero and Originality.ai.

Does ContentCraft AI support multiple languages?

Yes, ContentCraft AI supports multiple languages including English, French, Spanish, and German.

How does the Smart Linking feature work?

Smart Linking analyzes your existing content and intelligently suggests internal links to improve your site’s SEO structure. It also helps with external link recommendations based on your content.

Does ContentCraft AI handle images?

Yes, the plugin can automatically insert relevant images into your content and generate featured images based on your article topic.

Is the content SEO-friendly?

Absolutely! All generated content follows SEO best practices, including proper keyword placement, meta descriptions, and header structure.

How secure is the plugin?

ContentCraft AI is built with WordPress security best practices, including data sanitization, proper escaping, and nonce verification to protect against common vulnerabilities.

Can I schedule content generation?

Yes, you can set up a content calendar and schedule articles to be generated at specific times.

What happens when I uninstall the plugin?

When you uninstall Content Craft AI, all plugin data including database tables and WordPress options will be completely removed to keep your database clean.
